patch.description: Embed when removal is false, preserving the profile through CodeResources generation.

headerPatch.description: Use mach/machine.h and mach/vm_prot.h on Apple; avoid redefining SDK CPU macros. Portable block unchanged on other hosts.

entitlementsPatch.description: Normalize profile identity and keychain wildcards per executable; preserve app ID prefix vs Team ID; encode both XML/DER consistently; set executable flags from the actual debug boolean. Does not grant extra permissions or change Info.plist IDs.

installabilityPatch.description: Fail on nested signing/CMS errors, preserve mode on signature reallocation and symlink resource semantics; no signer cache or nil completion dereference.
